name: @momo/db-auth
//peerDependencies: `better-auth/next-js`'s nextCookies() dynamically imports `next/headers.js`, and better-auth SWALLOWS a 'Cannot find module' from it (dist/integrations/next-js.mjs) — the session cookie is then never set and sign-in silently leaves the user signed out. `next` resolves today only because pnpm dedupes it as better-auth's optional peer, driven by apps/web. Named here so the coupling is declared rather than inherited.
